# External Libraries

Third party dependencies.  Not written by Devacor; do not change them.

Notable packages:
- `Box2D` – physics engine.
- `asio` – networking; `openssl` – TLS; `libpqxx-6.4`/`postgres10` – lobby database; `spine` – skeletal animation.
- `LINQ` – boolinq C++ LINQ style queries (lobby server).
- `gl3w`, `glm` – OpenGL loader and math library; `Vulkan-Headers` – the Vulkan render backend.
- `VSProjects` – the Visual Studio projects that build these libraries.
